# Diego Sánchez (CuB1z) Portfolio

Diego Sánchez is a Software Engineer based in Madrid, Spain, focused on software
architecture, distributed systems and cloud. Recently graduated in Software
Engineering at Universidad Rey Juan Carlos (URJC); currently a Full-Stack
Developer at Génexys, building microservices with Python, FastAPI and AWS.

This is a bilingual single-page portfolio plus a blog. English is served at the
root; Spanish under /es.

## Navigation

- [Home](https://cub1z.es/): hero, experience, selected work and about, on one page. Spanish: [/es](https://cub1z.es/es/).
- [Writing](https://cub1z.es/blog): posts on engineering, architecture and the TripFlow project. Spanish: [/es/blog](https://cub1z.es/es/blog).
- /blog/<slug>: an individual blog post. Spanish: /es/blog/<slug>.

## Blog posts

Newest first. Spanish translations live under /es/blog/<slug>.

- [Introducing TripFlow](https://cub1z.es/blog/introducing-tripflow): a travel-planning PWA with AI itineraries and route optimization.
- [CI/CD & Testing TripFlow](https://cub1z.es/blog/ci-cd-testing-tripflow): backend and frontend setup, test suites and deployment pipelines.
- [TripFlow MVP](https://cub1z.es/blog/tripflow-mvp): authentication, itinerary management and a Dockerized, fully tested app.
- [TripFlow v0.2.0 (AI & Microservices)](https://cub1z.es/blog/tripflow-v0.2.0): AI itinerary generation and a Kafka-based microservices architecture.
- [Beyond the Monolith](https://cub1z.es/blog/beyond-the-monolith): when to adopt microservices versus keeping a modular monolith.
- [YAGNI in Practice](https://cub1z.es/blog/yagni-in-practice): avoiding speculative over-engineering and the maintenance tax it creates.
- [TripFlow v1.0.0](https://cub1z.es/blog/tripflow-v1.0.0): collaborative itineraries, secure share links, maps, offline access and PDF export.

## Experience

- Génexys Technology, Full-Stack Developer (Feb 2026 – present): microservices with Python, FastAPI and AWS.
- Telefónica Innovación Digital, Full-Stack Developer, internship (Jul – Dec 2025): Next.js, accessibility (WCAG), SEO and web performance.

## Featured project

- [TripFlow](https://tripflow.cub1z.es), Bachelor's Thesis (10/10): an AI-assisted travel planner with real-time collaboration and an offline mode, on a Spring Boot microservices backend with a React frontend.
